answer: Agents obtain identities only through SGX/TPM zero-knowledge attestations proving unique enclave keys and bounded firmware state; comet is the attestation hash anchor, river is the append-only identity state tree, and raven is the consensus verification circuit. Forging requires compromising distinct certified hardware or fabricating a valid ZK proof; each identity posts an O(N^2) quadratic bond, irreversibly slashed on equivocation.
